brandSources.from: https://www.pmi.com/ via scripts/brand-probe.mjs (--theme-color) and a screenshot of the home page
brandSources.note: The probe's top saturated colour; it is the site's theme colour and matches the blue progress banner on the home page. Contrast on white is about 5:1.

brandSources.what: bg #ffffff, surface #f6f6f6, text #262626, muted #6e6e6e, mode light
brandSources.note: Most-used colours on the site: #ffffff (381 uses), #000000, #6e6e6e, #25282a, #f6f6f6. Text uses the site's #262626 rather than pure black.

pivot #0074c0, oversight #003da5, cigarettes #dd1414 and deals #4d8f2f are site colours. products #00778b is my own dark teal, chosen to stay distinct from the site blues at dot size. origins uses the site grey #6e6e6e. scrutiny #c2410c is my own choice (a burnt orange) to make the critical cluster stand apart; it is not a PMI colour.

brandSources.from: https://www.pmi.com/ probe: Google Fonts link for Lato; computed families include Avenir / Helvetica Neue stacks
brandSources.note: Lato is on Google Fonts and is requested by the site, so it is used for body text with a Helvetica/Arial fallback. The real wordmark is not reproduced; the wordmark text is set in spaced capitals as an approximation and no logo is embedded.
